_readme: Source of truth for the three grades. tools/build-grade-pages.py renders
grade-fine.html, grade-medium.html and grade-coarse.html from this file and
templates/grade.html. js/site.js also loads it at runtime for the depth
calculator's per-grade bulk density and the grain-scale illustration.
Grain size, mesh, bulk density and primary use come from the brief and are
the values to build against. Everything marked TODO is invented placeholder
data and must be replaced before launch; see README.md.

grades.name: Fine
grades.title: Fine grade aragonite, 0.5–1.0 mm — specification and pricing | Aragonite Sand
grades.description: Fine grade oolitic aragonite, 0.5–1.0 mm (18–35 mesh). Supplied in 20 lb and 50 lb bags, 2,000 lb bulk bags and bulk by the ton for aquarium, agriculture, animal feed and turf.
grades.tagline: The finest of the three grades. Specified where a level bed, a fine texture or a high surface area per unit weight is required.
grades.card_use: Aquarium sand beds, soil amendment, feed and mineral blending, rootzone amendment.
grades.other_blurb: 0.5–1.0 mm. The finest grade. Highest surface area, lowest drift resistance.
grades.sieve_note: A narrow distribution. The bottom band is the fraction that carries over into suspension on first wetting.
grades.calc_intro: Bed area and depth to weight, at this grade's bulk density.
grades.calc_note: Beds compact over the first weeks. Add allowance if a finished depth is specified.

uses.title: Aquarium sand beds
uses.body: Settles to a level bed with a defined line at the glass. Specified for shallow sand beds and for substrate-sifting livestock.

uses.title: Soil and rootzone
uses.body: Highest surface area per unit weight of the three grades, which is what governs dissolution rate in soil and in growing media.

uses.title: Not for high flow
uses.body: Lowest drift resistance of the three. Where bottom flow sweeps the bed, or where an open porosity is required, specify medium or coarse.

grades.keywords: fine aragonite 0.5-1.0 mm, aragonite sand bed, aragonite soil amendment, feed grade aragonite

grades.name: Medium
grades.title: Medium grade aragonite, 1.0–2.0 mm — specification and pricing | Aragonite Sand
grades.description: Medium grade oolitic aragonite, 1.0–2.0 mm (10–18 mesh). Supplied in 20 lb and 50 lb bags, 2,000 lb bulk bags and bulk by the ton for aquarium, agriculture, turf and water treatment.
grades.tagline: The middle grade. The widest application range of the three, and the one most often specified when a single grade must cover mixed conditions.
grades.card_use: General marine and mixed reef substrate, soil and rootzone amendment, water treatment contact media.
grades.other_blurb: 1.0–2.0 mm. The middle grade. Holds position under higher flow than fine.
grades.sieve_note: Most of the mass sits in the two middle bands, which limits vertical sorting in a settled bed.
grades.calc_intro: Bed area and depth to weight, at this grade's bulk density.
grades.calc_note: Add allowance if a finished depth is specified after settling.

uses.title: General marine and mixed reef
uses.body: Holds position under the flow rates typical of a mixed reef while retaining the appearance of a settled flat.

uses.title: Rootzone and contact media
uses.body: Drains freely in sand rootzones and passes water in contact vessels without the packing a fine grade shows.

uses.title: Not for substrate sifters
uses.body: Substrate-sifting livestock require a particle that passes the gill rakers. Specify fine.

grades.keywords: medium aragonite 1.0-2.0 mm, aragonite substrate, aragonite rootzone amendment, contact media

grades.name: Coarse
grades.title: Coarse grade aragonite, 2.0–5.0 mm — specification and pricing | Aragonite Sand
grades.description: Coarse grade oolitic aragonite, 2.0–5.0 mm (4–10 mesh). Supplied in 20 lb and 50 lb bags and 2,000 lb bulk bags for aquarium, high-flow marine and water treatment.
grades.tagline: The coarsest of the three grades. Specified where flow resistance, open porosity or a larger contact particle is required.
grades.card_use: Cichlid and hard-water aquarium substrate, high-flow marine, water treatment contact media.
grades.other_blurb: 2.0–5.0 mm. The coarsest grade. Highest flow resistance, lowest surface area.
grades.sieve_note: Almost nothing below 2 mm. A coarse bed carrying fines packs and loses permeability.
grades.calc_intro: Bed area and depth to weight, at this grade's bulk density.
grades.calc_note: Coarse settles less than fine. Add allowance where the bed will be disturbed.

uses.title: Cichlid and hard-water systems
uses.body: Particle size suited to systems where the substrate is worked by livestock and where an open bed is wanted.

uses.title: High flow and contact media
uses.body: Highest flow resistance of the three. In a vessel or sump the larger particle maintains flow through the media rather than around it.

uses.title: Not for a level sand bed
uses.body: Reads as gravel rather than sand, and detritus passes into the bed rather than resting on it. Specify fine or medium.

grades.keywords: coarse aragonite 2.0-5.0 mm, aragonite gravel, aragonite contact media, high flow substrate
